profile.entities: Dev Information Technology Ltd (CIN L30000GJ1997PLC033479, Ahmedabad; offices Gujarat/Maharashtra/Rajasthan/Canada). Inbound: XDuce Infotech (US, acquired ~24–25% of DEV IT from promoters at market value; owns Fizentech — SOC2, IP product "Verify"). Subsidiaries/associates: GA / Dhyey Consulting (Microsoft Dynamics, acquired ~1.5 yrs ago; UCI New York to take 25% stake — signed last month, post-FY26); Minddeft (blockchain, acquired ~3 yrs ago); Dev Consulting (ERP). JV: Scaleax (4-company JV, GCC-as-a-Service in GIFT City). Divested: Talligence + ByteSIGNER products → Byte Technosys Pvt Ltd for ~INR 11.90 cr cash. Associate: Dev Accelerator (DevX) — IPO'd in FY26 (drove exceptional gain). Distribution: A21 Technologies (exclusive master distributor of Talligence in India/MENA).
profile.mgmt: Jaimin Shah (Managing Director & CEO — sole management voice); Harsh Gosavi (Kirin Advisors — moderator)
profile.subseg: Cloud Services; Managed IT Services (~27% of revenue); Digital Transformation; Enterprise Applications (Microsoft Dynamics / ERP); Business & Mobile Applications; Cybersecurity; AI; Blockchain; Data & Data Centre; (divested: products Talligence & ByteSIGNER)

deepdive.sec: IT Services — SMB/Mid-market Microsoft-led offshore delivery & Digital Transformation (Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, Blockchain)

bull_bear.body:
- Stake-sale-led restructuring: promoters sold ~24–25% to XDuce (cash to promoters, strategic partner in); UCI to buy 25% of GA/Dhyey.
- Product carve-out: Talligence/ByteSIGNER sold to Byte Technosys for INR 11.90 cr (frees cash, sharpens services focus, opens Talligence to outside strategic investors).
- Continued ESOP issuance to attract/retain talent.
- Dev Accelerator (DevX) stake monetisation optionality post its IPO (source of the FY26 exceptional gain).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **PAT quality:** headline FY26 PAT (INR 75.6 cr) is inflated by a non-cash DevX reclassification gain — underlying EBITDA only ~INR 7.23 cr. Watch for normalization next year.
- **Growth stall:** FY26 revenue +~5%; the INR 200 cr FY27 guide implies only ~3–4% growth — execution/integration must deliver before the 15–20% FY28 step-up is credible.
- **India-mix margin trap:** 67% India (lower margin) is a deliberate but profitability-dilutive choice; margin recovery hinges on export/enterprise mix shift.
- **Integration risk:** XDuce, UCI and GA integrations all in flight; UCI deal already slipped ~4–5 months; heavy management bandwidth consumed.
- **Small order book:** INR 50–60 cr vs ~INR 193 cr revenue → limited forward visibility; SMB churn risk (600–700 small customers).
- **Single-voice management:** only the MD/CEO on the call; some answers vague (deal-size data "not upfront"; cited "asked ChatGPT" for partner-ecosystem stat) — limited financial depth/IR rigour.
- **Blockchain underperformance:** repeatedly flagged as not picking up.
- **FX/geopolitics:** export ramp (US/UK) re-introduces the very geopolitical exposure FY26 strategy sought to avoid.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Candid about the deliberate trade-off (chose revenue/survival/India over margin amid geopolitical turmoil) and openly admitted margins fell. Strategic narrative (US on-site via XDuce, GCC JV, product carve-out, Microsoft designations) is coherent. But the call was MD-only with thin financial precision — no clean separation of operating vs exceptional PAT offered proactively, soft on KPIs (couldn't give deal-size trend or new-customer count), and one stat sourced from "ChatGPT." Tone optimistic/promotional on FY27–28 optionality; verify against the modest INR 200 cr near-term guide.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The INR 75.6 cr "net profit" is a value-trap headline: strip the Dev Accelerator (DevX) post-IPO reclassification gain and the business made ~INR 7.23 cr EBITDA on INR 193.5 cr revenue (~3.7% margin) — this is a small, low-margin SMB IT services shop, not a suddenly-profitable one.
- The strategic pivot is essentially being recapitalised by a US partner: XDuce buying ~24–25% from promoters turns DEV IT into XDuce's "global delivery centre" (80/20 split on non-India work) — the equity story now rides on XDuce/UCI deal flow, not organic India growth.
- Q4 margin (8.99%, +322 bps) is the more important signal than the full-year 3.74% — if the exit run-rate holds as India-mix/people investments normalise, FY27 operating margin should structurally improve even on flat-ish revenue.
- Product exit (Talligence/ByteSIGNER → Byte Technosys) + A21 distribution + outside-investor interest is a deliberate de-consolidation to unlock product value separately and stop cash drag — watch Byte Technosys / Talligence for a future value-unlock event.
- DevX (Dev Accelerator) is an embedded listed-equity optionality on DEV IT's balance sheet post its IPO — a non-IT-services swing factor in reported earnings.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Revenue mix (FY26):** India 67% (export ~33%). India govt+corporate crossed ~INR 110 cr. Export ~INR 45 cr (up from ~INR 35 cr — beat expectation). By tech, Cloud + Blockchain BU contributed most within the India 67%.
- **Service-line revenue (FY26):** Cloud ~INR 25 cr; Cybersecurity ~INR 5–8 cr; Managed IT ~27% of total revenue. Traditional manpower/staff-aug "single digits" (very low).
- **Customers:** ~600–700 live customers (SMB-heavy); ~35–40 strategic (enterprise + few government) added in FY26; repeat customers ~27–30% of revenue.
- **XDuce (US/UK):** strong in enterprise BFSI, healthcare, government/education; took ~24–25% of DEV IT from promoters; provides on-site delivery + enterprise customer acquisition. Brings Fizentech (SOC2-compliant, IP product "Verify") into cybersecurity portfolio.
- **GA / Dhyey Consulting:** Microsoft Dynamics focus; FY26 a consolidation year, pivoting to more US/Canada export clients; UCI New York to take 25% stake + >$3m US Dynamics business.
- **Scaleax JV:** 4-company JV providing GCC-as-a-Service, targeting GIFT City (Gandhinagar) — capture India GCC boom.
- **Product divestiture:** Talligence + ByteSIGNER sold to Byte Technosys (INR 11.90 cr) to keep DEV IT a pure service business; A21 Technologies signed as exclusive master distributor of Talligence (India + MENA; A21 = consortium of Tally's top 21 partners; Tally has >2m India / >1m intl clients).

latest_quarter.body:
- FY26 EBITDA margin ~3.74% (full year) but Q4 8.99% (+322 bps YoY) — exit run-rate improving.
- Margin drag drivers (mgmt): (1) deliberate India mix (low margin, chosen for de-risking); (2) lower FY26 exceptional income (~INR 4 cr vs ~INR 13 cr FY25); (3) strategic-alliance bandwidth from Oct/Nov onward; (4) people/skill-development investment for ABCD running longer than planned (expected done by Jun/Jul'25, ran into Dec/Jan), forcing third-party outsourcing at lower margin.
- Margin levers ahead: process strength keeping delivery cost low; XDuce/UCI front-ending cuts S&M/travel; exit of cash-hungry product business; shift toward higher-margin export/enterprise work.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q4 FY26 (this):** Q4 income INR 56 cr (+8.1% YoY), EBITDA INR 5.04 cr (+68.5%, margin 8.99% vs 5.77%), Q4 net profit INR 8.96 cr (vs INR 1.13 cr). FY26 income INR 193.5 cr (~+5%, low end of INR 190–200 cr guide), EBITDA INR 7.23 cr (margin ~3.74%), reported PAT INR 75.6 cr / EPS INR 13.25 (inflated by Dev Accelerator/DevX post-IPO reclassification gain). XDuce took ~24–25% from promoters; UCI to take 25% of GA (post-FY26); Talligence & ByteSIGNER products sold to Byte Technosys for INR 11.90 cr; A21 exclusive distributor signed; achieved all 6 Microsoft Solution Partner Designations. Order book INR 50–60 cr; ~1,000–1,100 staff; ~600–700 live + ~35–40 new strategic customers.
- _Next Q → check: (1) FY27 tracking to ~INR 200 cr revenue? (2) XDuce-sourced revenue hitting $1–2m, then $3–5m? (3) UCI 25% deal closed + >$3m Dynamics business landing? (4) operating EBITDA margin holding the Q4 ~9% run-rate vs full-year 3.74%? (5) India vs export mix shift toward higher-margin exports? (6) Canada/UK enterprise deals closed? (7) underlying PAT ex-DevX gain — normalize the headline._

outlook.body:
- **Revenue:** FY27 (current year) ~INR 200 cr; FY28 (next year) +15–20% over FY27.
- **XDuce-sourced revenue:** ~$1–2m in FY27 (integration year); ~$3–5m from FY27/onwards growing 15–20% YoY.
- **UCI:** UCI New York to take 25% stake (signed last month, post-FY26); to bring >$3m of US Microsoft Dynamics business for GA/Dhyey.
- **Margin:** No explicit target given; actions to lift margin = stronger processes, XDuce/UCI pipeline reducing sales/travel spend (DEV IT to become "XDuce worldwide global delivery centre"), exit of cash-hungry product business.
- **Mix intent:** Keep India as ballast (de-risk) but grow higher-margin US/UK/Canada/ANZ enterprise share over next 2–3 years.
- **Hiring:** Add more people in FY27 (from ~1,000–1,100 base).

outlook.body:
- Current order book ~INR 50–60 cr.
- Empanelled with Govt of India NIXI, Gujarat, Rajasthan and Chandigarh governments → India public-sector pipeline (selective: must be strategic, profitable, cash-flow-friendly).

outlook.body:
- **ABCD focus:** AI, Blockchain, Cloud, Cybersecurity + Data/Data Centre — the stated strategic priority for billing-rate uplift and relevance.
- **North America beachhead:** XDuce on-site + DEV IT offshore = hybrid model; revenue split convention ~80% DEV IT / 20% XDuce on non-India work.
- **US Microsoft Dynamics (via GA/UCI):** >$3m incremental pipeline.
- **GCC-as-a-Service (Scaleax / GIFT City):** optionality on India's captive-GCC wave.
- **6 Microsoft Solution Partner Designations + CMMI Level 5:** win-rate / credibility lever for enterprise + govt deals (mgmt cites ~5% of NA Microsoft partners hold all 6).
- **Blockchain (Minddeft):** couldn't scale in FY26 on weak market; optionality in exports + India govt.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: DEV IT deliberately paused growth in FY26 (revenue +~5% to INR 193.5 cr, below its own INR 190–200 cr guide and well short of ambition) to de-risk against geopolitical turmoil by leaning on lower-margin India government/corporate work (~67% of revenue, India biz crossed INR 110 cr) while building a US on-site beachhead via XDuce's ~24–25% strategic stake. Operating profitability is genuinely improving (Q4 EBITDA +68.5% YoY to INR 5.04 cr, margin 8.99% vs 5.77%), but the eye-catching FY26 net profit of INR 75.6 cr is almost entirely a one-time non-operating mark-up from reclassifying its Dev Accelerator (DevX) stake post-IPO — underlying EBITDA was only ~INR 7.23 cr. The real call is on FY27 execution: integrate XDuce/UCI/GA, convert the new US/UK/Canada pipeline, and re-accelerate to INR 200 cr (current-year) with 15–20% growth thereafter.
